name: claude-forge
description: Local-only forks of ui-craft, caveman, superpowers, and humanizer

plugins.name: ui-craft
plugins.description: Anti-slop UI design system: discovery-first workflow, layout, typography, color, motion, accessibility, and polish for production interfaces.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts 65% of output tokens (measured) while keeping full technical accuracy by speaking like a caveman.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Process skills for brainstorming, planning, TDD, systematic debugging, and parallel agent dispatch.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Remove signs of AI-generated writing from text, making it sound more natural and human. Based on Wikipedia's "Signs of AI writing" guide.
